name: Chicken Wrap with Curried Pineapple-Apricot Chutney & Mixed Greens
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Place half in a small saucepan. (Place the remaining pineapple in a medium bowl and set aside for later use.)
Small dice apricots and add to the pan with the pineapple.

Add water, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine the chutney and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
While the chicken is cooking, add oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the pineapple. Stir to combine the salad dressing.

Using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Place tortillas on a flat surface; spread each with a layer of mayo and chutney. Top with chicken and a small portion of salad. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
